findings.desc: quality-fail-closed: packages/main/src/handlers/certification-window.ts:87-102 collectAdmitFacts catch blocks set missingRequiredIntents=0 and openBlockingFindingIds=[] when coverage or finding/policy reads throw, so certification_window_begin can ADMIT. The same function fail-closes an unreadable dirty-tree classifier. PRE_CERT admit must refuse when required facts cannot be computed.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 6a26e8cc13: fail-closed admit/authorize plus smoke coverage for verifier drift, peer write, lane baseline, receipt binding, and retry storm.

findings.desc: quality-fail-closed: packages/main/src/core/certification-window.ts:266 windowAuthorizesHeavyCertification(window, null) returns Boolean(window.receiptId). loadVerifiedCertificationWindow:653-654 only verifies a receipt when one is found, so deleting receipts[] from certification-window.json while leaving a signed ADMITTED window+receiptId still authorizes done_required_validate / validate --full. A missing PRE_CERT receipt must fail closed.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 6a26e8cc13: fail-closed admit/authorize plus smoke coverage for verifier drift, peer write, lane baseline, receipt binding, and retry storm.

findings.desc: quality-fail-closed: packages/main/src/core/certification-window.ts:675-679 detectCertificationWindowMaterialDrift treats undefined current storyFilesHash/materialHash as no drift. currentMaterialHash/currentStoryFilesHash return undefined on git failure, so refresh/heavy keep an ADMITTED or RUNNING window live instead of invalidating. Unreadable frozen identity is not fail-closed.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 6a26e8cc13: fail-closed admit/authorize plus smoke coverage for verifier drift, peer write, lane baseline, receipt binding, and retry storm.

findings.desc: quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/handlers/certification-window.ts:43-48 persistHint swallows autoCommitStoryMetadata errors with an empty catch and returns empty string. Persist failures are PERSIST-class and must reportHealthIssue, not stay silent. A failed metadata commit after begin/cancel leaves a dirty unsigned window with no health trace.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 6a26e8cc13: fail-closed admit/authorize plus smoke coverage for verifier drift, peer write, lane baseline, receipt binding, and retry storm.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/certification-window-smoke.ts:683-688 CHK-004:test-or-verifier-mutation-invalidates is a must edge intent (material write to test or verifier inputs invalidates ADMITTED/RUNNING) but the pinned invalidation smoke only commits src/app.ts and then asserts State: INVALIDATED. currentCertificationIdentity always hardcodes PRECERT_VERIFIER_IDENTITY/PRECERT_TEST_IDENTITY (handlers/certification-window.ts:145-146), so the verifier/test identity-drift branch in detectCertificationWindowMaterialDrift (core/certification-window.ts:681-694) is never executed. Evidence note 'material change invalidates at next status' does not correspond to the test/verifier discriminator. high

packages/main/src/tasks/certification-window-smoke.ts:642-696 CHK-004:no-cross-story-dev-lock is a must adversarial intent (another story DEV write/commit in its own worktree succeeds; this window takes no repo-wide write lock; consumers persist INVALIDATED even if status was never called). The pinned invalidation/replay smoke never creates a second story or worktree, never attempts a foreign DEV commit, and never asserts the absence of a long-lived repo lock. Its evidence selector is only State: INVALIDATED from the same B-cw21 source commit, so the lock/isolation claim is uncovered. high

packages/main/src/tasks/certification-window-replay-smoke.ts:1-3 CHK-005:no-quorum-or-lane-weakening is a must adversarial intent (replay/smoke passing must not reduce required reviewer-lane or host-quorum counts vs the pre-story baseline). The pin is a 3-line re-import of certification-window-smoke.js with selector certification-window-smoke: PASS and note 'no lane or quorum policy change'. The smoke never reads reviewer-lane policy, quorum membership, or a baseline count; plan.md DoneWhen explicitly requires unchanged reviewer lane/host counts. This is broad PASS evidence that does not correspond to the intent. high

packages/main/src/tasks/certification-window-smoke.ts:671-675 CHK-003:admitted-heavy-binds-identity is a must happy intent (after admit, heavy commands bind receipts to the frozen window identity: headHash, expected main SHA, storyFilesHash, verifier/test identity, and do not spawn a second concurrent suite). The pinned heavy-choke smoke only asserts a detector marker file exists and status becomes RUNNING. It never inspects a done_required/validate receipt for the frozen hashes/identities. handlers/done-required-validation.ts:36-40 only calls refuseHeavyCertificationUnlessAdmitted (state flip) and does not attach window frozen identity onto command receipts. Selector is the hardcoded replay line, not identity binding. high

packages/main/src/tasks/certification-window-smoke.ts:623-631 CHK-003:no-child-on-retry-storm is a must adversarial intent (tight-loop retries of done_required_validate/validate --full without an admitted window still spawn zero heavy children across the storm). The smoke invokes each heavy entrypoint once and asserts the marker file is absent. Evidence note claims 'repeat refuse; zero heavy children' but there is no loop, no process-table sample across retries, and no assertion that a later retry cannot leak a child after the first refusal. medium
